in_hebrew.name: Nert
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Nert הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'neros', meaning 'young man' or 'warrior'. In Greek mythology, Nert is associated with the god Apollo and the virtue of courage.

in_latin.name: Nert
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Noble warrior
